name: Castellserà (Spain)
description: Red field with two white horizontal stripes, the upper one indented on its lower edge with nine teeth.
history: The official flag of Castellserà is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with two white fesses each of thickness 1/6 of the height of the cloth, the first with its lower edge indented with nine teeth, set at 3/12 from the respective edges; approved on 6 July 2017 and published in the DOGC on 14 July 2017.

features.role: stripe with its lower edge indented with nine teeth
